manaNeeded: {2} each odd-numbered turn, with {6} available each even-numbered turn
notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least three charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate's Scepter's abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate's Scepter's abilities, putting four charge counters on it.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
